Use case: ads-marketing. Deliver one finished high-end cinematic key visual for a Japanese adult AI learning studio website, not a webpage mockup. Landscape 3:2, exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels. Creative direction: human potential extending through collaboration with AI, expressed by beautiful flowing translucent silk-like light and exceptionally fine luminous neural filaments that emerge gently from actual laptop work and weave through the learning space. The image must unmistakably show real adult people LEARNING AI in a classroom, with teacher, learners, computers, natural purposeful interaction. Bold refined fine-art direction with the realism and light of an exquisite science-fiction film still, sculptural organic movement and layers, rich visual depth, not ordinary stock photography. Modern intimate Japanese learning atelier, tactile warm timber table, soft ivory walls, restrained deep petrol teal and sage, warm pearl and soft amber highlights, subtle film grain, skin with real texture, cinematic soft directional sunlight, believable anatomy. Light ribbons feel like elegant translucent flowing glass or delicate fabric, continuous graceful S-shaped composition, tiny branching threads symbolize expanded intelligence and connection, never cover faces. Clear warm human expressions, participants concentrate on laptop displays and share a moment of discovery. Humanistic, inviting, sophisticated and optimistic. Frame subjects with breathing room and keep all important faces and hands inside central 70% for existing responsive crops. Full-bleed scene, no border. No visible typography, words, letters, logos, watermark, UI overlays, infographics, robot mascot, humanoid android, cybernetic body parts, floating brain, gloomy dystopia, rainbow neon, stiff posed stock-photo smiles, plastic skin, miniature ceramic buildings or disconnected abstract still life. Illustrative AI displays may contain only quiet abstract nonverbal shapes.
Scene HERO / THE CLASSROOM: A medium-wide intimate learning scene with four Japanese adults, one approachable mentor about 45 standing slightly behind and between three seated adult learners of varied ages at a broad wooden table, two elegant unbranded laptops and an open notebook. Three-quarter camera view, mentor guides gently toward a screen while learners take part. People occupy center and lower two thirds; a sweeping pearlescent and teal transparent light ribbon rises from the working laptops, arcs softly around and above the group in a single elegant spacious curve, then expands into fine branching filaments toward the luminous upper background, suggesting their shared thinking opening out into possibility. A subtle Japanese lakeside town through soft-focus windows, almost incidental. Strong composition and quietly breathtaking cinematic atmosphere, inviting face lighting; a plausible AI classroom that becomes a work of art.
